endorsements.name: Rob Joyce
endorsements.label: Building Absurd Christmas Light Shows
endorsements.description: Learn about the elements that go into a computerized light display and how you outfit your own house with dazzling blinking lights set to music. Components of the show are individually explained and live demonstrations of the technology are on display. Come get inspired to computerize your own holiday cheer!
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 26

endorsements.name: Rob Joyce
endorsements.label: NSA Talks Cybersecurity
endorsements.description: The National Security Agency (NSA) has authorities for both foreign intelligence and cyber security. This unique position gives NSA insights into the ways networks are exploited and the methods that are effective in defending against threats. Over time, NSA has adapted the focus of its security efforts and continues to evolve with technologies and the adversaries we face. The talk will look back at some of the inflection points that have influenced NSA and US Government cybersecurity efforts and look at what is necessary to stay safe in the new environment.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 26

endorsements.name: Rob Joyce
endorsements.label: Changing Global Threat Landscape with Rob Joyce and Dark Tangent
endorsements.description: Rob Joyce, former NSA and White House cyber official, will engage with Dark Tangent to analyze the evolving state of global cyber threats. Their discussion will explore the impact and potential of artificial intelligence, assessing how AI is reshaping the cybersecurity landscape and what it means for the future of global security.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 32
